title: Prompt Engineering: An AI Product Manager's Practice
title_zh: 提示词工程 · AI 产品经理实践
excerpt: How product managers write good requirement prompts, told accessibly: a six-question framework (role, context, goal, input, constraint, output), a live rewrite of a vague requirement, two copy-paste-ready examples (PRD and prototype demo), and four techniques that make AI sharper every round.
excerpt_zh: 以产品经理视角，深入浅出讲透如何写好需求提示词：六个问题框架（角色、背景、目标、输入、约束、输出），一条模糊需求的现场改写，两套可直接复制的示例（PRD 与原型 Demo），以及四个让 AI 越用越准的进阶技巧。

title: How Product Managers Get the Most Out of Taste Skill (an AI Frontend Aesthetic Skill Pack)
title_zh: 产品经理如何用好 Taste Skill（AI 前端审美技能包）
excerpt: Taste Skill is an open-source aesthetic rule pack (SKILL.md) for AI coding tools that turns abstract "product taste" into executable design rules. This PM-focused guide covers its core value, a 4-step rollout from install to Pre-Flight acceptance, practical use cases in the PM workflow, and the five most common pitfalls.
excerpt_zh: Taste Skill 是给 AI 编码工具的开源审美规则包（SKILL.md），把抽象的「产品品味」变成 AI 可执行的设计规则。本文从 PM 视角讲透它的核心价值、从安装到 Pre-Flight 验收的四步落地流程、嵌入 PM 工作流的实战用法，以及五个高频踩坑点。

title: From Idea to Prototype: A High-Quality Delivery Playbook
title_zh: 想法转换原型 · 高质量落地实践分享
excerpt: Using a natural-language map agent as the running example, this article shares how to steer AI from idea to prototype: let AI play technical architect, manage its limited attention one round at a time, and hand it a concrete role model like wanderboat — with Figma design first, then a coding agent.
excerpt_zh: 以自然语言驱动的地图 Agent 为例子，分享如何把想法一步步引导成高完成度原型：让 AI 当技术架构师、像管理稀缺资源一样管理它的注意力、给它一个具体的榜样（wanderboat），并让 Figma 设计先行、再由 coding agent 照着实现。

title: Some Principles for Making a Good Product
excerpt: Some principles I follow when creating — put yourself in the user's shoes, approach as an outsider, care for every detail, improve step by step, and mind how the work presents itself.
excerpt_zh: 把创作时的几条心法记下来：把自己当作使用它的用户，以外部人员的视角来使用产品，关注每一个角落，逐步变好而不求一步到位，并留意作品面向谁、属于什么类型。

title: A Product Manager's Experience with Claude Code: How to Build a Semi-Production-Grade Interface Product
title_zh: 产品经理使用ClaudeCode心得：如何构建一个半生产级界面产品
excerpt: How a product manager set up the Claude Code environment from scratch — Windows & Linux, local & cloud — to independently build semi-production-grade, demo-ready UI products.
excerpt_zh: 产品经理如何从零搭建 Claude Code 运行环境，适配 Windows/Linux、本地/云环境，摆脱对研发的基础依赖，自主搭建可演示、可迭代的半生产级界面产品。
